prompt_text: I need a dental implant in Kansas City. Which specific dental practices should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Kansas City Missouri for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I just need a bit more info so I give you the most useful, local recommendations.

Quick questions:
1. Do you mean Kansas City, MO or Kansas City, KS (or a particular ZIP or neighborhood)?  
2. Do you prefer an oral surgeon, periodontist, or a general dentist who places implants? (Or do you want the highest-specialty center available?)  
3. Is insurance or staying in-network important? Any budget constraints or need for financing?  
4. Do you expect a complicated case (bone grafting, sinus lift, multiple implants, failing teeth) or a straightforward single implant?

If you prefer, I can also just give a short list of the top things to look for and exact questions to ask when you call — plus a template phone script — and then compile specific practices once you confirm your ZIP and preferences. Which would you like?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
